description: This file defines the 'GatewayNodeSession' actor responsible for managing WebSocket communication, handling node invocation requests, managing canvas URL capabilities, and coordinating connection states within an OpenClaw project setup. It includes helper functions for URL canonicalization, timeout handling for invoke requests, and event processing workflows.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket session, invocation, and event handling with the server in an asynchronous environment.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous invocation with a specified timeout, ensuring timely response handling or timeout responses.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with specified parameters, handling disconnections and reconnections.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the current WebSocket session and resets connection-related state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the canvas capability URL from the server, maintaining the current canvas host URL.
